channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Justin Holiday | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Justin Holiday from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jim Boylen on Justin Holiday, Wendell Carter
item.description:
“If you look at it, we’ve lost two of our best defenders in the Justin Holiday trade and Wendell Carter being hurt,”

Jim Boylen on Justin Holiday, Wendell Carter, Jan 18, 2019. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: John Paxson on Justin Holiday
item.description:
Bulls exec VP John Paxson:

“Letting Justin is go. He’s been a model teammate. But trade fits with our direction.”

John Paxson on Justin Holiday, Jan 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Justin Holiday
item.description:
KC Johnson:Fred Hoiberg on Justin Holiday:

“Haven't seen a lot of him. I've talked to people who do know him who say he's a wonderful kid, great teammate.”

Fred Hoiberg on Justin Holiday, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.
